title: Disney Plus App on Meta Quest Adds 3D Movies
excerpt: Over 60 three-dimensional films are arriving on the Disney Plus application for Meta Quest devices.
body_html:
A new update for the Disney Plus application on Meta Quest headsets is rolling out, introducing a selection of more than 60 three-dimensional movies for subscribers.

According to Meta, the newly supported content includes major titles such as The Avengers and Black Panther. The updated application becomes available to users today, allowing active Disney Plus subscribers to access the 3D film library directly through their virtual reality devices.
